problem_evidence.observed_gap: Clear explicit recall usually reaches qwen2.5:7b even when one selected working-memory record is already high-confidence; non-person named-entity recall also lacks a generic binding path.

falsifiable_hypothesis: A query-independent high-confidence recall seam can use one already-selected, speakable working-memory record without a LeftBrain model call while preserving exact-record removal, replacement, and irrelevant-removal behavior.
single_runtime_variable: Before the model planner, enable a generic explicit-recall rule only when the selected working-memory evidence passes all frozen confidence, separation, and speakability gates.
controls: same qwen2.5:7b model for all cases that do not pass the fast-path gate
same psyche, routing, Bayesian rerank, RightBrain, and post-check pipeline
same model generation parameters and local hardware
no benchmark, persona, or expected-answer content in runtime logic
no production memory writes or VRM actions during evaluation

development_checks.purpose: Regression and latency diagnosis only; not fresh generalization evidence.

failure_rule: Reject the mechanism if it exposes sensitive or ambiguous memory, activates on non-recall input, leaks removed content, or fails to reduce model calls without preserving causal plan behavior.
evidence_boundary: A development pass supports only that an already-selected high-confidence record can bypass the current LeftBrain model planner on explicit recall while retaining bounded causal behavior.
